lines: Electricity Production from Fossil Fuels, Nuclear Energy, and Green Energy, 2024
The graph above shows the amount of electricity produced from fossil fuels, nuclear energy, and green energy in four countries in 2024.
In Australia, fossil fuels produced almost twice as much electricity as green energy.
The U.S. had a higher rate of nuclear energy use than any of the other three countries.
The U.S. also had a higher rate of using fossil fuels and nuclear energy than the U.K.
In the U.K., the rate of electricity from nuclear power was less than one-third of the rate from green energy.
In Brazil, the rate of green energy use was two percentage points higher than the total rate from both Australia and the U.K.
